system.description: Also at 10th Level, your bond with your Sage Tribe has become unbreakable. You are their found family, and they are yours. You can gain a second Bonded sage creature, most likely one that is related to your first bonded creature but may also just be another member of the tribe you’ve grown close to, but its level is treated as half of yours (Rounded up). You can have both of your Bonded creatures summoned at once, and can now spend either your Action or Reaction to command the Bonded creature that has not been commanded this turn. Additionally, only one bonded creature can benefit from your Summoning Duality class feature at a time

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
